server.buildCommand: echo "== pulse: checking DB env" && node -e "const raw=process.env.DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED||process.env.DATABASE_URL||''; const u=raw; if(!u){console.error('== DATABASE_URL is missing in this build');process.exit(1)} const c=u.charCodeAt(0); if(c===34||c===39){console.error('== DATABASE_URL starts with a quote. Remove the quotes.');process.exit(1)} console.log('== DB url length:', u.length, '| prefix:', u.slice(0,11), '| source:', process.env.DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED ? 'DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED' : 'DATABASE_URL')" && echo "== pulse: generate" && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && echo "== pulse: db push" && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-$DATABASE_URL}" npx prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --skip-generate && echo "== pulse: seed" && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-$DATABASE_URL}" node prisma/seed.mjs
